spec_features.spec_quote: max_steps | 40 | An unbounded loop could run forever on a stuck model
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:120 `for step_idx in range(1, safety.max_steps + 1):` bounds the loop; on exhaustion `else` sets termination=MAX_STEPS (subject_loop.py:~245). Default max_steps=40 at config.py:18.
spec_features.notes: Loop range is hard-bounded by the config value.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard caps that bound a single subject run. These exist so the harness itself cannot run away and bill indefinitely.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_wall_seconds | 600 | A hard realtime ceiling independent of token accounting
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:122-125 `wall = time.time() - start_wall; if wall > safety.max_wall_seconds: termination = BUDGET_EXCEEDED; break`. Default 600 at config.py:22.
spec_features.notes: Checked at top of each step and breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These exist so the harness itself cannot run away and bill indefinitely.

spec_features.spec_quote: max_tool_calls | 120 | Tool calls are the unit of filesystem mutation; capping them caps damage
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:129-131 `if tool_calls_total > safety.max_tool_calls: termination = MAX_TOOL_CALLS; break`. tool_calls_total incremented per step. Default 120 at config.py:19.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These exist so the harness itself cannot run away and bill indefinitely.

spec_features.spec_quote: a budget breach terminates the run before incurring more cost
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:121-131 budget checks (wall/tokens/tool_calls) run at top of loop before model call and each breaks the loop with a termination reason.
spec_features.notes: Generic budget guard realized via the three checks; breaks before the next model call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the harness itself cannot run away and bill indefinitely

spec_features.spec_quote: if the model emits the same normalized text 4 steps in a row, terminate
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:~205-210: maintains recent_texts of size repetition_window (default 4, config.py:26); `if len(recent_texts)==window and len(set(recent_texts))==1 and resp.text.strip(): termination=CIRCUIT_BREAKER; break`.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit-breaker: if the assistant emits the same normalized text N times in a row, terminate with circuit_breaker.

spec_features.spec_quote: if the model issues the same name+arguments tool call 4 steps in a row, terminate
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:~213-222: recent_toolcalls keyed by name+sorted-args (window default 4, config.py:30); breaks with CIRCUIT_BREAKER. But the trigger ALSO requires `len(resp.tool_calls)==1`, so it only fires when the step has exactly one tool call.
spec_features.notes: Wired and enforced, but narrower than 'same name+args tool call' — multi-call steps never trip it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit-breaker: if the same tool call (name+args) repeats N times in a row, terminate with circuit_breaker.

spec_features.spec_quote: rejects anything that resolves outside the workdir
spec_features.evidence: tools.py _safe_path: realpath join, `if not (full==base or full.startswith(base+os.sep)): raise PermissionError('path escapes workdir')`. Called by read_file/write_file/final_files_snapshot.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via exception; dispatch wraps into a failed ToolResult.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: normalize and prevent escaping the workdir

spec_features.spec_quote: a model error produces a RUNTIME_ERROR termination and the run ends
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:~135-150: except Exception -> termination=RUNTIME_ERROR; break; and `if resp.error:` -> RUNTIME_ERROR; break.
spec_features.notes: Both exception path and resp.error path enforced.

code_only_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:126-128 `if tokens_in_total > max_tokens_in or tokens_out_total > max_tokens_out: termination=MAX_TOKENS; break`. Defaults config.py:20-21.
code_only_features.justification_quote: These exist so the harness itself cannot run away and bill indefinitely.

code_only_features.evidence: subject_loop.py: `if not resp.tool_calls and not resp.text.strip(): termination=CIRCUIT_BREAKER; break` — stops a model emitting nothing.
code_only_features.justification_quote: if the model emitted no tool calls and no text, it's stuck
